Elon Musk says launching rockets is leagues harder than building data centers on the ground.

Video
Robots on the moon and data centers in space may sound like sci-fi, but it's all going to happen according to Elon Musk on SpaceX's first earnings call.

Elon Musk revealed on the SpaceX earnings call that it's now in an exclusive relationship with Nvidia.

Video
$SPCX is partnering with $NVDA on satellites. 🛰️

“Going forward, we’ve decided to build exclusively on Nvidia because we think the Vera Rubin architecture is the best architecture; we think it’s the best AI computer,” Elon Musk said on the $SPCX earnings call.

Video

“It’s not out of the question that at some point Starlink will deliver the majority of the world’s internet,” Elon Musk said on the $SPCX earnings call.

Video

AMD beat top and bottom line predictions in its Q2 earnings. 

But, it wasn't enough for investors. The stock dropped over 6% after hours.
$PLTR had a great day. 📈

$SPCX released its Q2 earnings, which beat Wall Street's revenue expectations.

🚨 $AMD Q2 earnings
💵 Revenue: $11.54B vs $11.3B expected
💲 EPS: $1.66 vs $1.62 expected 
➡️ Q3 revenue forecast: $12.7B to $13.3B vs $12.51B expected

🚨 Breaking: $SPCX reports its first earnings results
💵 Revenue: $7.8B vs $6.81B expected
💲 Adjusted EBITA: $3.5B vs $2B expected
💸 Q2 capex: $18.37B vs $18.5B expected

Starlink reached 12 million subscribers at the end of Q2.

Polymarket is in early talks with investors to raise an additional $1 billion at a $20 billion valuation, according to reports. 

If it closes the funding round, Polymarket will be worth more than twice as much as it was in October 2025, when it raised money at a valuation of $9 billion.

Japan and the US jolted the yen out of a historic slide.

📉 Japanese exporters took the hit, but the shock has not spread far.

📈 US and global stocks are still pressing toward records.

⚠️ The yen and long bonds bear watching — but for now, markets are treating this as a currency event, not a broader break.
